notes.title: 사진 속 글자 읽기
items: 넣기 탭에 사진 글자 단추 추가, 표나 목록 사진을 읽어서 칸에 넣기
한 줄은 한 행으로, 탭이나 띄어쓰기 두 칸 이상으로 떨어진 글은 다음 열로 나누어 넣기
넣기 전에 읽은 글을 고칠 수 있고 몇 행 몇 열로 들어가는지 미리 표시
사진은 이 기기 안에서만 읽고 어디로도 보내지 않음

en.title: Read text from a photo
items: New Photo text button on the Insert tab: reads a photo of a table or list into cells
Each line becomes a row; text separated by a tab or two or more spaces goes into the next column
The text can be corrected before it goes in, with a preview of rows and columns
The photo is read on this device only and is never sent anywhere

notes.title: 행·열 묶기
items: 행·열 탭에 행 묶기, 열 묶기, 묶기 풀기, 모두 접기, 모두 펴기 단추 추가
묶은 줄 아래(오른쪽) 머리글의 −, + 단추로 접고 펴기, 묶은 단계는 머리글 옆 띠로 표시 (7단계까지)
엑셀 파일로 저장하고 열어도 묶음과 접힌 상태 그대로 (outline)
행·열을 넣거나 지울 때 숨긴 줄과 묶음이 같이 움직이도록 고침

en.title: Row and column groups
items: New buttons on the Rows & columns tab: group rows, group columns, ungroup, collapse all, expand all
Fold and unfold with the − and + button in the header after a group; levels (up to 7) show as a bar beside the header
Groups and their folded state are kept when saving to and opening .xlsx (outline)
Hidden lines and groups now move along when rows or columns are inserted or deleted

notes.title: 함수 130개 더
items: INDIRECT, OFFSET, ADDRESS, XMATCH, FORMULATEXT, CELL 같은 참조 함수 추가
LET과 LAMBDA, MAP·REDUCE·SCAN·BYROW·BYCOL·MAKEARRAY 추가
TAKE, DROP, CHOOSEROWS, CHOOSECOLS, EXPAND, TOCOL, TOROW, WRAPROWS, WRAPCOLS, RANDARRAY, FREQUENCY, TREND, LINEST 추가
시간(TIME, HOUR, MINUTE, SECOND), DAYS360, YEARFRAC, NETWORKDAYS.INTL, WORKDAY.INTL 추가
재무 함수 RATE, IPMT, PPMT, CUMIPMT, CUMPRINC, XNPV, XIRR, MIRR, DB, DDB, SYD 외 추가
2진·8진·16진 변환, 비트 함수, 행렬 함수(MMULT, MDETERM, MINVERSE), t·카이제곱 분포, T.TEST, Z.TEST, AGGREGATE 추가
ROW(B5)와 COLUMN(B5)가 오류로 나오던 문제 고침
LET 같은 새 함수는 엑셀 파일로 저장할 때 값으로 저장 (엑셀에서 열면 깨지지 않게)

en.title: 130 more functions
items: Reference functions: INDIRECT, OFFSET, ADDRESS, XMATCH, FORMULATEXT, CELL
LET and LAMBDA with MAP, REDUCE, SCAN, BYROW, BYCOL, MAKEARRAY
TAKE, DROP, CHOOSEROWS, CHOOSECOLS, EXPAND, TOCOL, TOROW, WRAPROWS, WRAPCOLS, RANDARRAY, FREQUENCY, TREND, LINEST
Time (TIME, HOUR, MINUTE, SECOND), DAYS360, YEARFRAC, NETWORKDAYS.INTL, WORKDAY.INTL
Finance: RATE, IPMT, PPMT, CUMIPMT, CUMPRINC, XNPV, XIRR, MIRR, DB, DDB, SYD and more
Base conversion, bit functions, matrices (MMULT, MDETERM, MINVERSE), t and chi-square distributions, T.TEST, Z.TEST, AGGREGATE
Fixed ROW(B5) and COLUMN(B5) returning an error
Newer functions like LET are saved as values in .xlsx so Excel opens the file cleanly

notes.title: 리본 탭 정리
items: 홈 탭에 몰려 있던 기능을 서식, 행·열, 보호·인쇄 탭으로 나눔
데이터 탭에서 숨기기와 틀 고정, 잠금을 각각 행·열 탭과 보호·인쇄 탭으로 옮김

es.title: Pestañas de cinta reorganizadas
items: Las funciones que se amontonaban en la pestaña Inicio se reparten en las pestañas Formato, Filas·Col. y Proteger·Imprimir
Ocultar, inmovilizar paneles y bloquear se pasan de la pestaña Datos a las pestañas Filas·Col. y Proteger·Imprimir

fr.title: Onglets du ruban réorganisés
items: Les fonctions regroupées dans l'onglet Accueil sont réparties entre les onglets Format, Lignes·Col. et Protéger·Imprimer
Masquer, figer les volets et verrouiller passent de l'onglet Données aux onglets Lignes·Col. et Protéger·Imprimer

de.title: Menü-Reiter neu geordnet
items: Die im Start-Reiter gedrängten Funktionen sind jetzt auf die Reiter Format, Zeilen·Spalten und Schutz·Druck verteilt
Ausblenden, Fenster fixieren und Sperren wurden vom Daten-Reiter auf die Reiter Zeilen·Spalten und Schutz·Druck verschoben

ja.title: リボンタブを整理
items: ホームタブに集まっていた機能を、書式・行・列・保護・印刷の各タブに分けました
データタブにあった非表示・ウィンドウ枠の固定・ロックを、行・列タブと保護・印刷タブへ移しました

zh.title: 整理功能区标签
items: 把开始标签中堆在一起的功能分到“格式”“行·列”“保护·打印”标签中
数据标签中的隐藏、冻结窗格和锁定分别移到“行·列”和“保护·打印”标签

pt.title: Abas da faixa reorganizadas
items: Os recursos que estavam amontoados na aba Início foram divididos nas abas Formatar, Linhas·Colunas e Proteger·Imprimir
Ocultar, congelar painéis e bloquear saíram da aba Dados e foram para as abas Linhas·Colunas e Proteger·Imprimir

ru.title: Вкладки ленты перестроены
items: Функции, собранные на вкладке «Главная», разнесены по вкладкам «Формат», «Строки·Столбцы» и «Защита·Печать»
Скрытие, закрепление областей и блокировка перенесены с вкладки «Данные» на вкладки «Строки·Столбцы» и «Защита·Печать»

tr.title: Şerit sekmeleri düzenlendi
items: Giriş sekmesinde toplanmış özellikler Biçim, Satır·Sütun ve Koruma·Yazdırma sekmelerine ayrıldı
Gizleme, bölme dondurma ve kilitleme Veri sekmesinden Satır·Sütun ve Koruma·Yazdırma sekmelerine taşındı

it.title: Schede della barra riorganizzate
items: Le funzioni raccolte nella scheda Home sono divise nelle schede Formato, Righe·Col e Proteggi·Stampa
Nascondi, blocca riquadri e blocca sono passati dalla scheda Dati alle schede Righe·Col e Proteggi·Stampa

pl.title: Karty wstążki uporządkowane
items: Funkcje zebrane na karcie Start rozdzielono na karty Format, Wiersze·Kol. i Ochrona·Drukowanie
Ukrywanie, zamrażanie okienek i blokowanie przeniesiono z karty Dane na karty Wiersze·Kol. i Ochrona·Drukowanie

ar.title: إعادة تنظيم تبويبات الشريط
items: وُزّعت الميزات المتكدسة في تبويب الصفحة الرئيسية على تبويبات التنسيق والصفوف·الأعمدة والحماية·الطباعة
نُقلت ميزات الإخفاء وتجميد الأجزاء والقفل من تبويب البيانات إلى تبويبي الصفوف·الأعمدة والحماية·الطباعة

en.title: Ribbon tabs reorganized
items: Features crowded on the Home tab are split into Format, Rows·Cols and Protect·Print tabs
Hide, freeze panes and lock moved from the Data tab to the Rows·Cols and Protect·Print tabs

글자 크기 9~28, 글꼴 4가지(고딕, 명조, 고정폭, 손글씨)

Format painter brush

Goal Seek
Formula tracing (shows the cells this cell uses and the cells that use this cell)

es.title: Más funciones de Excel

Tamaño de letra de 9 a 28 y 4 fuentes (Gótica, Serif, Monoespaciada, Manuscrita)
Pincel de copiar formato

Masquer des lignes et des colonnes, et les afficher à nouveau
Insérer des images, les déplacer par glisser-déposer et les redimensionner
Valeur cible
Audit de formules (affiche les cellules utilisées par cette cellule et celles qui l'utilisent)
L'enregistrement et l'ouverture de fichiers Excel conservent le souligné, le barré, la taille de police et les lignes et colonnes masquées

Beim Speichern und Öffnen von Excel-Dateien bleiben Unterstreichung, Durchstreichung, Schriftgröße und ausgeblendete Zeilen und Spalten erhalten

字号 9 到 28，4 种字体（黑体、宋体、等宽、手写）

Ao salvar e abrir arquivos do Excel, o sublinhado, o tachado, o tamanho da fonte e as linhas e colunas ocultas são mantidos

ru.title: Новые функции Excel
items: Подчёркивание (Ctrl+U) и зачёркивание (Ctrl+5)

Pędzel formatowania

en.title: Removed delete confirmation
items: Sheets and documents are now deleted right away without a confirmation window
After deleting, an undo notice appears at the bottom for 7 seconds so you can restore it at once

es.title: Sin ventana de confirmación al borrar

Tras borrar, aparece 7 segundos un aviso abajo para deshacer y recuperarlo al instante

fr.title: Fin de la confirmation de suppression
items: Les feuilles et documents sont supprimés tout de suite, sans fenêtre de confirmation
Après suppression, un message d'annulation s'affiche 7 secondes en bas pour tout rétablir aussitôt

de.title: Löschbestätigung entfällt
items: Blätter und Dokumente werden sofort ohne Bestätigungsfenster gelöscht
Nach dem Löschen erscheint 7 Sekunden lang unten ein Rückgängig-Hinweis zum sofortigen Wiederherstellen

ja.title: 削除の確認画面をなくす

消した後、画面下に元に戻す案内が7秒間出て、すぐ復元できる

zh.title: 取消删除确认窗口

pt.title: Sem janela de confirmação ao apagar

Depois de apagar, um aviso para desfazer aparece por 7 segundos embaixo e dá para restaurar de imediato

ru.title: Убрано подтверждение удаления

it.title: Eliminata la conferma di cancellazione
items: Fogli e documenti vengono cancellati subito, senza finestra di conferma
Dopo la cancellazione compare per 7 secondi un avviso per annullare e ripristinare subito

pl.title: Usunięto potwierdzenie kasowania
items: Arkusze i dokumenty są usuwane od razu, bez okna potwierdzenia
Po usunięciu na dole przez 7 sekund widać komunikat cofania, by od razu przywrócić

ar.title: إزالة نافذة تأكيد الحذف

nw.title: Delete ask window gone

After delete, undo notice shows 7 seconds at bottom, can bring back at once

gk.title: 지우는 확인 창 없애다
